method: Visually inspected the actual Penpot PNG exports: all three row exports and the full comparison board.
findings: Exactly three alternatives, each containing one initial and one mid-run bar.
All eight tag names, icons, widths and centered gold precision areas are visible in both states.
Header and instruction text clear the corner engravings; legend spacing corrections are present.
Narrowed Small and Predator zones retain their own precision areas, with exterior labels avoiding truncation.
Precision feedback in the parchment variants and ordinary tag-hit feedback in the dark variant are distinct and contained.
Native geometry audit confirms all 48 zone widths and precision centers, plus one independent marker per bar.
scope: Static visual studies only. No runtime resizing, timing, probability or gameplay implementation. No Unity integration.
